notes: We are sorry: earlier 2.7 and 2.8 builds could lag, freeze and leave extra PulseKRN icons in the tray. 2.8.2 was rebuilt step by step and checked after every change.
FIXED Freezes and lag: every command PulseKRN runs now has a hard time limit, stuck tasks are released, Auto-pilot restarts itself if it stalls, and a freeze report is written to error.log
FIXED Extra PulseKRN icons in the tray: the icon is removed every time PulseKRN closes, and QUIT always ends the process
FIXED Settings are saved safely, and a damaged settings file can no longer cause problems
FIXED The header only shows work you started, the loading spinner never covers the screen, the activity log can no longer push things off screen
FIXED Battery health, Disk Doctor speeds, Windows Update reset and the restore point message in Repair Center
FIXED White title bar and white message boxes: everything is dark from the moment the window opens
NEW Lite Mode (F9): Normal, Aggressive, Extreme and Ultra Fast levels or single tweaks, shows what is ON, REVERT or UNDO EVERYTHING puts the original settings back
NEW Update Control (Ctrl+U): block Windows Update for 7, 14 or 30 days or until you unblock it, with one-click unblock and protection while Windows is installing
NEW Smarter Auto-pilot: optimise by RAM, by timer or both, choose how often RAM is checked, and optionally close safe updater helpers when RAM is high
NEW Auto-pilot can start when you sign in to Windows (one tick box, clearly shown)
NEW Repair Center keeps its recommended steps on every tab, OPEN runs the check, finished steps disappear
NEW Keyboard shortcuts: F1 help, F5 refresh, Ctrl+1..9, Ctrl+PgUp/PgDn, F9 Lite Mode, Ctrl+U Update Control
NEW After you choose administrator once, PulseKRN asks for it again each time you open it (switch it off on the Auto-pilot screen)
NEW SEND TO SUPPORT on the News screen opens an email draft to havenova.x@gmail.com with the app name, version and error details filled in (you press Send), plus OPEN ERROR LOG and OPEN DATA FOLDER
NEW Every screen scrolls, and the activity log can be hidden (Ctrl+L) and cleared
Everything Havenova X has built is being gathered at havenovax.vercel.app
